4th Period.workingNow: Checking your GitHub account: if it works, forking the starter repo (steps in Google Classroom); if you never made one, creating a Codeberg account instead.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub account created, starter repo forked, and GitHub Pages live with your first name and one image on the home page — no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can get either a GitHub fork or a new Codeberg account working so that I have a coding account ready to build on.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.16 — Incorporate existing code, media, and libraries into original programs, and give attribution.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Warm-Up: Chromebooks out, try logging into GitHub (3 min)
I do: teacher explains the two paths — fork on GitHub vs. sign up on Codeberg (4 min)
We do: split by path — GitHub group forks the starter repo per Google Classroom steps; Codeberg group creates their account (14 min)
You do: confirm your fork (GitHub) or new account (Codeberg) is live (6 min)
Exit Ticket: Paste your fork link OR Codeberg profile link in Google Classroom (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday you tried to set up a GitHub account — for some of you that worked, for others it didn't. Today we get everyone onto a working platform, either GitHub or Codeberg. Tomorrow we'll build on whichever account you have live.

6th Period.workingNow: Writing your About Me page content: your favorite color, favorite animal, favorite game, and where you're from — each in at least one complete sentence, formatted so it's easy to read.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Google Site home page live with a nav menu and one image, and the Getting to Know You survey submitted.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can write at least one complete sentence answering each About Me question, using a readable font and color, so that visitors can get to know me on my site.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.21 — Discuss issues of bias and accessibility in the design of existing technologies.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present and describe ideas and information clearly.
agenda: Warm-Up: Think of your favorite color, animal, and game (3 min)
I do: teacher shows a sample About Me answer — one full sentence, readable font/color (5 min)
We do: draft one example sentence together for "Where are you from?" (5 min)
You do: write at least one complete sentence for all four questions and format your page so it's easy to read — add more if you'd like (14 min)
Exit Ticket: Submit your About Me page link in Google Classroom (3 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday you got your site's navigation working. Today you fill in your About Me page with real content about yourself. Tomorrow classmates will get to read about you.
